authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The giraffes possess an excessive number of legs (polydactyly/fusion), with limbs merging into the body without clear anatomical joints. The transition between the ceramic-patterned torso and the metal skeletal legs is abrupt and physically implausible. While the rendering quality (lighting, texture) is high, the anatomical coherence is severely compromised.
key_defects: Unnatural fusion between giraffe torso and leg assembly
